description: LF-normalized UTF-8 byte sizes of the files every default (non-economy) run reads, at v0.18.0 (ddef6ef). HotFileBudget.Tests.ps1 keeps each within perFileThreshold bytes of this baseline and the set within totalThreshold, so economy procedure stays in the cold references/economy-mode.md and a default run reads what v0.18.0 read. A hot file gets at most a one-line pointer.
